method_review.purpose: Financial-method guardrails for unranked reported-cash and funding-context view; underlying values unchanged.
summary_rules: Cash view is unranked. A sort by reported cash must say so explicitly and show direction; sorted position is not a financial-health rank.
Show the cash observation date, source rounding and company/subsidiary scope. Different reporting dates stay visible.
Always label company-wide credit total as not established. Count selected reviewed same-date facilities, not all facilities or all available credit.

Positive reported_available can be described as issuer-reported remaining availability, subject to source conditions and precision. Conditional unused_capacity must say conditional and name the facility/use scope.
Remaining LC capacity requires an explicit remaining label or semantic flag. Never use all lc_capacity entries: many are total limits or overlapping sublimits.

Borrowing caps and LC limits restrict the commitment; they are not additional available cash. Never compute commitment minus carrying debt, add cash plus facilities, or sum selected facilities into a company total.
When no same-date facility facts are verified, say that directly. A zero selected-facility count is not evidence of no credit.
Unknown restricted balances remain unknown. Source-reported zero borrowings does not establish available capacity.
